doc.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25

title: Forgetting old record lyrics and never reading music
summary: Shade cannot recall the words of one of his records, remembers titles but not tunes, and says he has never read music.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
